notes.title: For The Warp is 5 years old!
notes.content:
Hello!

To celebrate our anniversary we started yesterday with an 80% off discount.

We just added a new branch called 'console-version' that features the... console version of the game!

Yes, the console version is a distinct version but we decided to include it here mostly because of the better gamepad support, but lacking some of the features of the steam version.

Just a disclaimer if you plan to play it:
- Better gamepad support
- Runs better on older or slower hardware
- Save games and progression is different from the main game, you won't lose your previous saves if you go back to the 'regular' version.
- Does not have Steam achievements (we might fix this later)
- No 'Warpopedia'
- Does not have the new ship from the latest update
- Some minor differences in balance/difficulty

To play this version:
Right click the game in the library > Properties > Betas > Beta Participation (drop down) > select 'console-version'

Also, people recently asked for more translation options. 
We did have some old incomplete translations to Portuguese, Russian and other languages that never were officially released.
The plan is to fully translate them and make it available in the coming months.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4 - Many balance changes
notes.content:
This patch brings a lot of small changes and balances a lot of small things to improve the early game for new players. It will make the game easier in regular mode and make it more easy to progress in the hardcore mode levels.


 Reduced HP for the boss in the first systems
 Reduced HP and starting shields for enemies in the first 3 systems
 Reduced the card market costs for common cards and many other costs for cards adjusted
 Last Resort damage reduced to 20
 AI Supremacy nerfed, only spawns 3/3 drones
 Special Circumstances now gives more damage to bosses
 Kinetic Barrier buffed to 8 damage
 Overheated Shields and Beast Mode now have ignite synergy to allow for more card combos
 Crippling Ion now deals a bit more damage
 Mythic cards will only drop on bosses from the 3rd system onward


That is all for now but more balances and checks are on the horizon.

notes.title: For The Warp 1.0 is out now!
notes.content:
For The Warp is now out of Steam early access!

Version 1.0 brings new cards, equipment, a new ship and many other small changes.

But this doesn't mean the end of updates and at least one big update will be coming this summer with content that didn't make the cut.

The Missile Cruiser is now available to unlock, but you need to defeat the big boss at the 'secret' system Tempestra.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/c2589e35dc4e0cdfc9058882ebc284adcc4011ff.png

It has an onboard antimatter cruise missile factory and an antimatter cannon to deliver time sensitive mayhem.

There are 7 new cards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/218d7939e1fc20ebee7d3f4f99a5870044337819.png

And also 5 new equipment cards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/3cf3d05f1883e9dbd6de8cf765a8fcc65a38221e.png

And other features and fixes:


 Steam Achievements!
 The Boss on Achlys system now might reveal its true form!
 Some new cards got new art
 Balanced some repair and scrap card costs in the later systems
 Events are more unique and don't repeat that often.
 Infinite hardcore levels are available and got some balances


What is next?

This is not the end of the updates!
A small list of things coming in the next few months:


 Steam Deck and controller support
 New events that didn't made the cut for 1.0
 Translations! (should arrive soon)
 At least 5 new equipment cards
 QOL updates, more options and customizations


And finally you can also check the game on Nintendo Switch, that might be a bit behind on the latest updates but will be patched in the coming months also.

Thank you!

notes.title: Content Updates & 1.0 Release Date
notes.content:
Hello!

First I want to announce that For The Warp is leaving early access this Monday, March 28!

Also the game is now available on Nintendo Switch!

The 'Infinite Update' was released last week so here is the short change list:


 'Infinite' Hardcore levels. Each time you beat the game the hardcore level increases
 Changed keyboard shortcuts during combat. 'E' - Ends turn, 'A' - Play Deck, 'D' - Deck, 'ENTER' - Use selected card
 Minor fixes and changes for upcoming updates


With the 'infinite' hardcore mode levels you get increasing difficulty after you beat the game with any ship.

Hardcore Mode levels:


Enemies give more damage as each level increases with a cap at level 5.

And these are specific difficulty modifiers that unlock once you reach that level:

3: Only repair 25% arriving at new systems
5: Repair costs increased
7: Lower credit rewards on victories
10: No repair at new systems
11: Repair costs increased
13: Regular enemies gain higher shield
15: Bosses gain higher shield
17: Aggressiveness for all enemies increased
20: All Bosses and Elites deal more damage
23: All Bosses deal even more damage
25: Final Boss deals ludicrous amounts of damage
27: Enemy Support ships heal more
30: All Bosses deal ludicrous amounts of damage


If you're interested in testing the upcoming 1.0 version, there is already a build in the test branch!
Just right click on the game in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas -> Select 'test-test' on the drop down.

While the 1.0 version will be mostly feature complete, there is still at least one planned update to be released later this summer, with some events that didn't made the cut and Steam Deck support.

Thank you!

notes.title: Warpopedia Update - Part II
notes.content:
Hello!

This is another update with new cards and new equipment that bring new core rule changes.

First these are the new play cards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/1a816d265d238abdec71dcbdb8d5c1c67ecf43f3.png

Void Box is the first card that creates a new random card that is added to the player hand.
And Warp Missiles gives you an accumulating bonus for NOT playing the card.

And these are the new equipment cards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/a6ae7ded9aad10efa8966e38475933fb8fa76b07.png

Single Thread Chip disables all card shuffling while playing, so you can carefully plan all the cards, since the order of the cards is always fixed.

Scrapper Crew is very useful if you want to reduce your deck size. Remember you can always equip and unequip while in the map screen, so you can do any equipment change before entering a fight or a station.

Other changes:

 Optimae Shielding is now a rare card
 Recurring Obliterator base damage now starts at 6
 Some regular enemies can now have visible damage shown
 If you are out of fuel, you now lose 40% of your credits to gain 5 fuel
 Music volume issues when you start a game have now been fixed
 Run history now correctly counts boss kills
 Minor polish changes to the UI
 Windows scaling is now ignored, and it should make all 1080p screens look pixel perfect in full-screen
 Other minor bugs


Also if you missed the Summer Sales, you can now buy it again for 30% off in the next 6 days!

Thanks everyone!

- 4 new cards:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/5c3239b80481ded33e2446ea92167b6a26bac22d.gif

notes.title: Balance changes
notes.content:
Alpha 0.9.4 brings several small changes to cards, ships and others:


 Standard Frigate HP increased to 85 and starting Fuel increased to 15
 KD Carrier HP increased to 65
 Ignite/Fire effects now deal the same damage as the number of turns the effect lasts. If the fire effect lasts 3 turns it will deal 3 damage, then 2 damage and so on. This will give a big damage reward when you stack ignite dots.
 Missile MK11 damage increased to 12
 Inspiring shot damage increased to 6
 Rocket Salvo now deals 18 damage and you buy a card
 Orbiting shield drones increased to +3 shield capacity
 Drone Attack Wave and Drone Boost now launch a drone if you have no drones
 Point Defense will no longer drop during play, it's now only a starter deck card
 Reckless Attack damage increased to 25
 Heavy Drone is now 5/2
 Management Expert now also gives you 2 Boost points
 Lowered the price of some common cards
 Small bug fixes, Support ships are now back to working properly


There will be more balance changes coming soon and another content update later this month!

Thank you everyone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/9eef8cd258efb2c9f8444b14c967739789da2820.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/608a375960801173de32a75fc46ba9e48e474572.png

notes.title: Alpha 0.7.0 - Rendezvous Update
notes.content:
Hi!

The Rendezvous Update brings new encounters, UI improvements, new cards and equipment.
Other small content updates will also drop in the coming days.

New cards and mechanics

The new Synergy mechanic allows you increase the card effects if you have another card in your hand with the same word in the title or synergy wording. It can also be applied to mechanic names or card rarity:
https://i.imgur.com/pGbwVyD.png

For example, if you have Plasma Affinity in your hand, the card itself will count as one 'Plasma' card in hand, but if you have another card with 'Plasma' in the name, it will also give the effect on number 2.

With 'uncommon synergy' it counts if you have any uncommon cards in hand and 'Ignite Synergy' applies to all cards with the Ignite mechanic in your hand.

Other new cards (some art is temporary):
https://i.imgur.com/yeyWAnj.png

With 'dual cards' you can choose which effect you want, so they become more versatile but not as powerful.

New encounters
https://i.imgur.com/22phvCc.png

You can now encounter big space habitats, selling cards, equipment and also repair facilities, card scraping options and refueling.

The distress signal in the system map will also give new encounters and options.

The casino station is not yet available but it will be online in the next few days.

https://i.imgur.com/AJmM42R.gif

Card Changes:

 Ammunition Spares now has a 'Scrap card' effect
 New cards (shown above)
 New Equipment cards: Ram Upgrade, Emergency Charger


Gameplay Changes:

 Hardcore Mode (will probably be balanced a lot in the coming weeks)
 You can now repair 10HP or more in the space stations
 New encounters: Space Habitat, Space Wreck, Crate 'Radar Scan' result
 If you run out of fuel, you will lose 30% of your credits in exchange for 5 fuel
 You can only find one Temple Ruins per system


Other bug fixes and improvements:

 SFX system during combat has been improved. Let us know if you are still have sound issues or performance related issues.
 New Music Tracks!
 New UI for the equipment tab
 'AI Supremacy' card sound issue
 Fixed an issue with the ship moving in the map while you are still in other encounter window.
 Other minor issues


I will keep adding new content in the coming days since they need a bit more testing.

Thank you!

notes.title: Alpha 0.6.3 - New cards, more balance changes and options
notes.content:
Hello!

This version brings some new content, features and fixes, so here it goes:

Two new cards, and a new mechanic called Synergy.

https://i.imgur.com/41V7v7y.png

In this case Uncommon Synergy applies when you have 1 or more uncommon cards in hand. 
Since the card itself is uncommon, it does at least the effect on 1, but if you have another uncommon card in your hand, it also executes the effect on 2.

There will be more Synergy cards coming later.

Card changes:

 'AI Supremacy' now Deactivates, so you can only use it once per combat
 Two new cards, Mass Driver and Modular Cannon


New Content:

 The 4th and 5th system bosses now have damage sprites
 New stations on the 3rd and 4th system
 You can now control the volume of music and sfx
 New display options and you can now resize your game window
 You can change the font to a regular vectorial font, or back to the pixel art font.
 New 'play deck' icon, where you can see what cards are in your deck, while in combat.


Other fixes:

 Some issues with equipment cards have now been fixed, from proper working buffs to color coding when activating an equipment.
 Bosses were not doing proper damage, and now have been fixed to the 'regular' difficulty
 Difficulty has been increased for some specific 'disable card' strategies.
 Performance optimizations for older computers or specific set of hardware configurations


Still a lot of known issues to fix, so expect smaller patches in the coming days.

A big thank you to everyone who reported some of these issues!

notes.title: Alpha 0.6.2 - The Balance update
notes.content:
Hello!

This version brings a long list of card changes, new enemy mechanics and bug fixes.

 Several equipment cards are no working correctly
 Ignite now deals 2 damage per turn
 You can now see your deck list while in the big market station or regular stations
 New enemy debuff, 'Shield Interference' that reduces your max shields
 New enemy buff, 'Disruptor Field' that makes the ship impervious do 'disable' effects
 You can now skip cards that are received in crates or temple runs.
 Enemies now have an 'enrage' mode, if you take too long to kill them, they can either try to escape or start giving more damage!
 'Shields charge' effect increased by 1
 'AI supremacy' price reduced to $299 but expect this card to be nerfed in the near future...
 'Extreme prejudice' also gives bonus damage when ship is on fire (from ignite ability)
 'Inspiring Resilience' now gives 5 shields
 'Ion Pulse' now also draws a card
 Explosive mechanic now gives 100% damage to ship hull
 'Plasma Wave' increased to 5 damage and 'Plasma Napalm' increased to 10.
 'Power Reroute' now deactivates all your hand
 'Repair drones' now repair 8hp but deactivates.
 'Special circumstances' now deal 40 damage to bosses
 'Thief Drone' now also draws a card
 'Time to Think' now costs 0
 'Twisted Firestarter' has increased to ignite 3
 'Weapons charged' now also draws a card
 'Flak Gun' increased to 7 damage to one enemy and 3 damage to all
 Several minor bug fixes! 


Because of the big list of gameplay changes, there are more adjustments coming soon and probably some bugs introduced.

Next week there is going to be more content with new cards, encounters and locations.

Thank you all for the feedback!

notes.title: Alpha 0.6.0 introducing a new playable ship
notes.content:
Hello!

The 3rd playable ship is now available, you just need to defeat the boss in the 3rd system to unlock it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36316189/114e3f3e1bf6200d7e3df23ddb54f5e3892bda71.gif

It's a knife-drone carrier, so the starting deck only has drones as an offensive weapon. While the ship is harder to play in the first systems it gets more powerful in the late game with more equipment capacity.

Also, the launch discount on Steam is ending in less than 2 hours, and there won't be any price discounts for the next few months!

Here is a list of updates:

 'KD Carrier' ship is now available
 Increased the probability of the 'scrap card' option on space stations
 Increased the energy cost of some 'disable' type cards
 There are 7 new equipment cards that can be bought in market stations
 'Unlimited Power' and 'Bribe' cards should now work correctly
 Minor UI improvements
 Small performance improvements during combat


That is all for now, if you find any bugs, report them on the community forums.

Thank you and stay safe!

notes.title: For The Warp upcoming content and patch
notes.content:
Hello!
First I would like to thank everyone for the great feedback and support during the launch.

A small update with bug fixes was released today, fixing some of the issue reported in the last couple of days.

The first big content update is coming later this week, with the 3rd playable ship called KD Carrier:

https://66.media.tumblr.com/ecfffab9a4009646fdca6ed9ae54eb4a/aaf9bb5aaa26c736-be/s640x960/d0a5597970b84dc36a4901032a4ac7f5e4d96063.gif

It's a drone carrier ship that has a on-board assembler of attack drones.
While it lacks mounted weapons, it has plenty of offensive power via drone cards and also boasts a larger bay for equipment cards.

The ship is almost ready, it just needs a couple more days for testing and should be available by the end of this week.

Meanwhile here are the patch notes for alpha 0.5.1:

 'Crypto Hack' is now working properly
 'Panic Crew' deals the correct amount of damage
 Some issues with the map grid generation are fixed
 Small UI and tooltip issues have been corrected


There are other bug fixes coming later this week, but if you find anything or just want to give feedback please leave them on the steam community forums.

Thank you!
